sources.title: KMG 2025 company introduction, page 33, KIC whole-track aerial
sources.observation: Operator publication depicts two separate pit compounds: northern permanent-circuit garages and southern GP pit building. Page 33 opened and visually reviewed. Photograph capture date unspecified.

sources.title: OpenStreetMap KIC pit lanes and buildings
sources.observation: Northern permanent pit way 234768719/building 234773074 differs from southern GP pit way 234767156/building 236254488. Photo correspondence checked against operator aerial.

sources.title: On-site photograph of KIC permanent pit garage facade, Bonta 2019
sources.observation: Original photograph explicitly captioned permanent pits; visible doors 19–21, brown lower masonry, pale metal upper facade, upper windows and a flat terrace railing. Image is the paddock-facing side; do not infer race-side painted box markings from it. Photograph capture date is not stated; 2019-08-09 is the article publication date.

sources.title: KIC official 2026 AKRC Round 5 pit allocation
sources.observation: AKRC operates on permanent track; official allocation lists garages 1–30. No spatial stall dimensions are supplied.

metadata.coverage: Distinct photo-confirmed northern permanent pit facility; geographic footprints matched against operator whole-circuit aerial.
limitations: Northern permanent pits are separate from southern GP facility.
Official 30 garages represented with evenly spaced doors; roof/eave details and height simplified.
Race-side work-apron depth is conservative because source roof footprint and mapped pit lane are close.
No race-side painted work-box rows are evidenced by the reviewed rear-facade photo; no imaginary service-box markings added.
metadata.geometryMethod: OSM footprints and pit-lane centerlines transformed with TrackRace.buildTrack(circuit).projection; apron/wall offsets visually estimated from photographs.
metadata.referenceMediaDistribution: Photographs/PDFs retained in gitignored output/pit-references for local verification only; no source image is bundled.

properties.evidence: Northern permanent pit lane visually matched to operator whole-circuit aerial, separate from GP southern lane. Narrow mapped lane; 4 m rendered width estimated.

Mapped northern permanent garage building. Two-storey pale upper facade and flat roof verified by visitor photo; 30 bays supported by 2026 official allocation. Race-facing doors are simplified and height 9 m is estimated.
Only narrow visually supported pavement along the roof edge is reconstructed. OSM roof outline and lane are close; do not create a wider apron crossing the mapped travel lane. Depth approximate.
Linear divider parallel to permanent pit lane in operator aerial. Approximate 0.8 m wall height and extent. Kept clear of main straight.
